final_full_data_method_freeze.full_data_refit: Use the frozen method family, simulation-selected neural profile, primary feature budget, and all 78 cases without outcomes.
final_full_data_method_freeze.primary_rule: Choose the model_id selected most frequently by inner-CV one-SE selection across all outer splits.
final_full_data_method_freeze.tie_breaker: Lower complexity_rank, then lexicographically smaller model_id.
final_full_data_method_freeze.uncertainty_rule: If no model reaches 40% selection frequency, do not claim a unique winner. Freeze the two most frequently selected non-failed methods as co-primary representations and report method uncertainty.

TARGET_selection_policy_preserved.interpretation: 05e freezes the proposed SABLE-MO implementation before final-gate/TARGET work; it does not replace the already-frozen outcome-blind TARGET nested-CV and final full-data method-selection rules.

component_formulas.modality_balance_score: normalized entropy of view contribution energy

target_nested_selection.neural_early_stopping_rule: Each inner model-selection split has a deterministic fit, early-stop, and validation partition. The validation partition is never used for early stopping. After selecting an epoch on the early-stop subset, refit on fit plus early-stop samples for that fixed epoch before scoring the inner validation subset.
target_nested_selection.one_standard_error_rule: Choose the lowest-complexity eligible model whose mean inner-CV utility is at least best_mean - standard_error_of_best.
target_nested_selection.outer_test_evaluation: Each outer-training split has a deterministic fit and early-stop partition. Select the epoch without outer-test access, refit on all outer-training samples for that fixed epoch, then evaluate once on the untouched outer test fold.
target_nested_selection.tie_breaker: Lower complexity_rank, then lexicographically smaller model_id.

mandatory_secondary_reporting: descriptive logistic trend on raw n scale, OR per +25 samples
D01.primary_estimand: familywise false biological acceptance over the prespecified final-gate null registry

D02.aggregation: total true biological shared factors matched-and-retained / 400 true biological shared-factor opportunities
D02.favorable_direction_disclosure: This selector clarification probably increases TPR by excluding harder mixed-support and sparse/dense loading stress scenarios; it also reduces selected datasets from 400 to 100. The clarification is frozen before final-gate data exist because STANDARD and standard_n62_signal1 were already prospectively named.
D02.selector: scenario_family == 'final_independent_gate_curve' and n_samples == 62 and shared_signal_strength == 1.0 and shared_factor_correlation == 0 and batch_mode == 'none'

D03.aggregation: FNR = 1 - D02 TPR on the identical pooled denominator
D03.independence_status: algebraic mirror of D02, not independent evidence

final_gate_required_next.failure_rule: A preregistered final-gate failure changes the scientific conclusion, not the criterion. No threshold, architecture, stability rule, eligibility rule, or selector may be retuned in response to final-gate results.

freeze_basis.confirmatory_neural_ablation: 05d4 completed all prespecified V0-V5 confirmatory held-out evaluations; 05d4a provides paired, hypothesis-matched component evidence without adding a new decision threshold.
freeze_basis.confirmatory_stability: 05d5 completed the frozen V4 post-fit resampling stability analysis on all 360 confirmatory datasets with zero failed dataset shards and zero latent-collapse datasets.
freeze_basis.cross_family_context: 05c1 BLOCK_PCA/PCA, 05c2b MOFA, and 05d4 neural results are summarized on the same confirmatory dataset bank for context only. No cross-family selection score/rule was prospectively frozen for 05e, so none is invented here.
freeze_basis.profile_selection: 05d2/05d3 selected and froze ARCH_COMPACT__REG_WEAK from development simulations under the pre-existing hard-gate plus one-standard-error profile rule.
freeze_basis.prospective_identity: 05a designated V4_SABLE_MO as the proposed primary method before model fitting and explicitly did not guarantee it would win.
freeze_basis.secondary_external_comparators: 05cmp1 froze iCluster2b and MOVE implementations before 05e; no scientific comparator result exists or influences this freeze.
